name: Set-Theoretic Domain Inclusion
description: Replaces the explicit edge-counting or algebraic definition of a clique with a set-theoretic mutual inclusion condition. It defines an "incompatibility domain" for each vertex (the vertex itself plus its neighbors) and defines the target structure as a set $S$ that is a subset of the incompatibility domain of every vertex in $S$. This mathematically strictly defines a clique but obscures it from surface-level pattern matching, punishing naive literal implementations with TLE.
